quote_original: Are you living in the dead past?
context_before: You are this very night, as you are seated here, pictured in this 5th chapter of Mark. A cemetery is for one purpose: it is simply a record of the dead.
context_after: If you are living among the dead, your prejudices, your superstitions, and your false beliefs that you keep alive are the tombstones behind which you
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: What is this issue of blood?
context_before: You are now the woman with the issue of blood.
context_after: A running womb is not a productive womb. She held it for 12 years, she was incapable of conceiving. She could not give form to her longing because of the running of the issue of blood. You are told her faith closed it. As the womb closes it can give form to the seed or idea.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: So I do not discuss it.
context_before: The child or state you desired is now your fixed concept of yourself. But now having assumed that I am what formerly I desired to be, I cannot continue desiring what I am conscious of being.
context_after: I talk to no one concerning what I am. It is so obvious to me that I am what I wanted to be that I walk as though I were.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: I no longer look for confirmation.
context_before: With the door of my senses closed, what do I take into that disciplined state? I take no one into that state but the parents of the child and my disciples. I close the door against the mocking, laughing crowd.
context_after: I completely deny the evidence of my senses, which mock my assumption and do not discuss with others whether my assumption is possible or not.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: I am conscious of the state.
context_before: Who are the parents? We have discovered that the father-mother of all creation is man’s I AMness. Man’s consciousness is God.
context_after: I am the father-mother of all my ideas and my mind remains faithful to this new concept of self. My mind is disciplined. I take into that state the disciples, and I shut out of that state everything that would deny it.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard

context_before: I say, Come out of the dead past. Come out of that cemetery and walk, knowing that you and your Father are one, and your Father, who men call GOD, is your own consciousness.

selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Of what are you conscious of being?
context_before: k, knowing that you and your Father are one, and your Father, who men call GOD, is your own consciousness. That is the only creative law in the world.
context_after: Although you cannot see your objective with the limited focus of your three-dimensional mind, you are now that which you have assumed you are. Walk in that assumption and remain faithful to it.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Are you resurrecting the dead child?
context_before: You be the judge of the position you now occupy in this 5th chapter of Mark.
context_after: Are you still in need of having that womb of your mind closed? Is it still running and therefore cannot be fertile? Are you now the insane man living in the dead past? Only you can be the judge and answer these questions.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Desire disturbs the mind of man.
context_before: The pool is your consciousness. The angel is an idea, called the messenger of GOD. Consciousness being God, when you have an idea you are entertaining an angel. The minute you are conscious of a desire your pool has been disturbed.
context_after: To want something is to be disturbed.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: You are not bearing his likeness.
context_before: He tells you the one you would like to have for your husband is not your husband. In other words the sixth has not yet impregnated you. What you would like to be is denied by these five, and they hold the power, they dictate what you will accept as true. What you would like to accept has not yet penetrated your mind and impregnated your mind with its reality. He whom you call husband is really not your husband.
context_after: To bear his likeness is proof that you are his wife, at least you have known him intimately. You are not bearing the likeness of the sixth; you are only bearing the likeness of the five.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And gradually I become what I feast upon.
context_before: He tells these, “I have meat ye know not of. I am the bread that droppeth down from heaven. I am the wine.” I know what I want to be, and because I am that bread I feast upon it. I assume that I am, and instead of feasting upon the fact that I am in this room talking to you and you are listening to me, and that I am in Los Angeles, I feast upon the fact that I am elsewhere and I walk here as though I were elsewhere.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard

quote_original: But between New York and St.
context_before: I went down to Furness, Withy & Co. with my letter and let them read it. They said, “We received the cable Mr. Goddard, but unfortunately we have not any space left on the December 6th sailing. The only thing available is 3rd Class between New York and St . Thomas. When we get to St. Thomas we have a few passengers who are getting off. You may then ride lst Class from St. Thomas to Barbados.
context_after: Thomas you must go 3rd Class, although you may have the privileges of the lst Class dining room and walk the decks of the 1st Class.”
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Do you know what he said to me?
context_before: ack to my friend Abdullah on the afternoon of December 4th and said, “It worked like a dream.” I told him what I had done, thinking he would be happy.
context_after: He said, “Who told you that you are going 3rd Class? Did I see you in Barbados, the man you are, going 3rd Class? You are in Barbados and you went there 1st Class.”
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: He thought he originated the act.
context_before: I was identified with the feeling of being there. I slept as though I were there, and the entire behaviour of man was molded in harmony with my assumption. I did not need to go down to Furness, Withy & Co. and beg them for a passage, asking them to cancel some one who was booked 1st Class. I did not need to write my brother and beg him to send me some money or buy me a passage.
context_after: Actually, to this day, he believes that be initiated the desire to bring me home.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: They call it the fourth-dimensional unit.
context_before: We have today in our modern world a little word which confuses most of us. I know it confused me until I dug deeper. The word is “action.” Action is supposed to be the most fundamental thing in the world. It is not an atom, it is more fundamental. It is not a part of an atom like an electron, it is more fundamental than that.
context_after: The most fundamental thing in the world is action.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 3 -Thinking Fourth-Dimensionally (1968-01-01).
